instruction: Disable the automatic screen brightness adjustment feature on your Ubuntu system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling ambient light sensor by setting org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power ambient-enabled to false. Evaluator verifies the setting value using gsettings get command.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks that ambient-enabled setting is false (disabled)
Getter logic is correct: uses gsettings get to retrieve the actual state of the ambient-enabled setting
Metric logic is correct: exact_match properly compares the result with expected value 'false\n'
Expected value is correct: 'false\n' matches the output format of gsettings get command when setting is disabled
Complete coverage: single-step task has single verification that checks the exact requirement
